timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I need help, and I do not want to ask.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am afraid of becoming a burden.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me believes I should handle this alone.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep minimizing how overwhelmed I feel.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body tenses when I imagine making the request.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I worry they will think I am incapable.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am afraid there will not be room for what I need.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that asking feels vulnerable.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Trying to do everything alone is exhausting me.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can make one clear request.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Needing support is part of being human.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Asking gives the other person a choice.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be specific about what would help.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften before I reach out.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: A request does not make me incapable.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: A no would not mean my need is unreasonable.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can choose someone who may have capacity.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let support become possible.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to ask for the help I need.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can speak honestly without overexplaining.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to make a respectful request.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can receive support without apologizing for existing.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can stay grounded while I ask.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am still capable when I collaborate.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can adjust if this person is not available.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Connection can make difficult things more manageable.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to reach out.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
